godot_material.emission_operator: MULTIPLY (the default, ADD, lights the whole model in the lamp's colour)
godot_material.import: Compress Mode: Lossless, Mipmaps: on (Godot keeps L8 as it is; RGB8 is padded to RGBA8 on the GPU)
godot_material.normal_texture: normal.png, loaded as RG8 (Image.convert(Image.FORMAT_RG8)): the shader rebuilds Z; pixel-identical, 2 bytes not 4
